description.zh: 官修正史，记载三国时期历史
description.en: Official dynastic history of the Three Kingdoms period, one of the Twenty-Four Histories

sources.notes: Primary historical source. Chen Shou served the Jin Dynasty and had access to Wei, Shu, and Wu archives.

title.en: Annotated Records of the Three Kingdoms

description.zh: 裴松之为三国志所作注解，引用大量已佚史料
description.en: Pei Songzhi's extensive commentary on Records, preserving many lost historical sources

sources.notes: Commentary doubles the length of original text. Critical for resolving historical conflicts.

date_range.note: Exact date uncertain, various editions exist

coverage_period.description: From Yellow Turban Rebellion to Jin unification, with literary embellishments

description.zh: 历史小说，基于三国历史创作，融合历史事实与文学虚构
description.en: Historical novel based on Three Kingdoms period, blending historical facts with literary fiction

artistic_license.note: Traditional saying: 七分实，三分虚 (70% fact, 30% fiction)

sources.notes: One of the Four Great Classical Novels of Chinese literature. Hugely influential in shaping popular perception of the period.

description.zh: 东汉官方史书，记载东汉历史
description.en: Official history of the Eastern Han Dynasty

sources.notes: Chapters 54-90 cover late Eastern Han period (184-220 CE) most relevant to Three Kingdoms

title.en: Romance of the Three Kingdoms (English Translation)

description.en: First complete English translation of Romance of the Three Kingdoms
